---
title: "Prerequisites"
toc: false
---

Before Day 1, install:

- R
  - [Windows](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/)
  - [Mac](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/). If you have a new Mac, you may also need [Fortran](https://mac.r-project.org/tools/)
- Either [RStudio](https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/#rstudio-ide-oss-downloads) or [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/download.html)
  - Positron is a data-science oriented fork of VS Code. It is useful if you plan on working frequently in both Python and R. RStudio is R focused.

::: callout-note
## Setup office hours

Arrive from **1:00–2:00 p.m. on Day 1** if you have issues installing R or RStudio/Positron.
:::
